selected_evidence.requirement: Record every sudo command with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log
selected_evidence.summary: sudoers validation passed. Captured records contain timestamps, invoking user 'antrieb', target user 'root', and full commands, including a successful post-restart test.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep sudo command entries out of the general system log
selected_evidence.summary: Unique pre- and post-restart test commands produced zero matches in messages, secure, and the journal. Persistent configuration contains 'Defaults !syslog'.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799. The native reboot command disconnected the transport before its shell acknowledgement printed; its acceptance is recorded in the persistent sudo log. The node became unavailable, recovered with boot ID 5d6afe67-3f7b-4772-82eb-9da68b21bc7b, and retained valid configuration, active rsyslog, prior log data, and correct live logging behavior.
